idea-plugin.name: Squill
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for Squill database projects in Rider.

Squill brings SSDT-style declarative, code-first database projects and DACPAC deployments to PostgreSQL and MariaDB/MySQL. Define your schema as .sql files, and Squill works out the changes needed to bring a database in line with it.

Features

  • Provider-aware SQL dialect. The provider declared in <SquillProviderName> is applied to the project's .sql files, so highlighting and inspections match the database you are actually targeting: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, or MySQL.
  • Cross-file object resolution. References between .sql files resolve without a live database connection, so navigation and completion work against the schema as written in source. A view can select from a table in another folder, or a foreign key point at another schema.
  • Deploy and Script run configurations. Generate a deployment script to preview a change, or apply it to a target database, without leaving the IDE. Table rebuilds, dropping objects not in source, and data-loss protection are all configurable, defaulting to the safe behavior.
  • Project recognition. .squillproj projects get a database icon in Solution Explorer. They are standard MSBuild SDK projects, so Rider loads, builds, and cleans them natively.

Deployment targets a connection you have already configured in Rider's Database tool window. Credentials stay in the IDE's credential store, and are never written to the run configuration, which is typically committed to version control.

The Deploy and Script run configurations require the Squill CLI (dotnet tool install --global Squill). All other features work without it.
